## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 24 авг. 2026 г. - 26 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _y. Reddy_, 26 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Editing to respond to the developer: When the 'free' experience is frustrating and ineffective, yes you should be sorry. This app is like using a calculator that makes you pay for the total after you hit 'enter'. You decided to put basic nutritional information behind a paywall because of greed and nothing else. Your free features are useless I forgot why I deleted this app years ago. Putting everything from protein onwards behind a paywall is a gross cash grab and you should be ashamed."
            2. _RJ_, 26 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "too many notifications about upgrading from a paid premium account to an even more expensive premium plus account. I can't disable those notifications that come up every other day. you guys are already collecting money from me, but you want more for an upgraded experience? I'll be requesting a refund and finding another app."
            3. _Richard Mead_, 25 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "So much is behind a subscription based paywall that using the app for more than basic tracking is useless. Use a less restricted app instead of mfp"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Реклама** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Реклама.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: реклама.
      Период отзывов: 24 авг. 2026 г. - 24 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи замечают давление рекламы. Это сигнал о friction в монетизации и возможном преимуществе для более чистого конкурента.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Robyn Scott_, 24 авг. 2026 г., 3/5: "Ads are slow to load and cause the page to shift just as you're about to touch your screen. Audio in ads is annoying and takes over other audio. Otherwise, this is the best tracking app I've ran across, but I won't recommend it until the ad issued are gone."
<!--/ir-theme-->

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Mozart Archilla_, 26 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Facebook authentication is broken, can't login"
            2. _enka cacka_, 25 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke. and developer response to visit some generic site just proves how useless this is and lost cause. stay away dont waste time."
